title: High Pointe 44W
meta_description: Beautifully updated with breathtaking panoramic views of the emerald and white shores of the Gulf of Mexico, High Pointe 44W is the pristine two-bedroom home you’ve been dreaming of for your next coastal escape.

normalized_matching_profile.name: High Pointe 44W
normalized_matching_profile.description: DescriptionBeautifully updated with breathtaking panoramic views of the emerald and white shores of the Gulf of Mexico, High Pointe 44W is the pristine place you’ve been dreaming of for your next coastal escape. Bathed in an elegant, neutral color scheme that’s both relaxing and the ideal backdrop for such a gorgeous locale, this two-bedroom gulf-front home is inviting and open, with a community with an impressive list of resort-style amenities.You’ll have two convenient, assigned parking spaces, and an efficient elevator will take you to this 4th-floor oasis. Once inside, you’ll be stunned by the open living space and the large glass doors that frame the Gulf of Mexico views. In the LIVING AREA, a dove gray sectional sofa and an armchair surround the large HDTV. But you might find that you spend all of your time on the covered balcony, where the gentle sea breezes and sounds of the ocean tides are endlessly relaxing.Back inside, the DINING SPACE has seating for six, is illuminated by a chic chandelier, and is entirely open into the KITCHEN. Crisp, classic white cabinets surround the stainless steel appliances, which include an electric range, a microwave, a refrigerator, and a dishwasher. There’s plenty of space to prepare banana pancakes for your crew before you hit the beach or blend frozen margaritas for happy hour cocktails.The PRIMARY BEDROOM SUITE is located just off the living area and features a luxurious king-size bed, access to the gulf-front balcony, and a sizeable ENSUITE BATHROOM with a step-in shower. The GUEST BEDROOM includes a queen-size bed plus a twin-over-twin-size bunk bed. Another FULL BATHROOM has a double vanity and a tub/shower combo surrounded by classic subway tiles, and a LAUNDRY NOOK with a stacked washer and dryer is accessible from the hallway.The beauty of High Pointe 44W lies in the balance between a perfect, private oceanfront home and an incredible array of resort-style extras that guests can enjoy. Besides the stunning beach right outside your door, you can also take a dip in the lazy river swimming pool, relax in the hot tub, play a round of tennis on the courts, or take a stroll and explore the charming surrounding community and grab a bite to eat or an ice cream cone.HIGHLIGHTS• Breathtaking gulf-front views from 4th Floor• Pristine, updated design• Spacious and open layout• Laundry nook• Parking for two vehicles• Outdoor lagoon-style pool and hot tub• Tennis courts, shuffleboard, playground• Charcoal grilling areas• Gulf-front bar and grill - Crabby Steve’s• Complete Clean Bedding Program• High-speed WIFI internet• Delicately tucked away between Rosemary and Alys Beach• Located in the gated community of High Pointe• 2 Complimentary Seasonal Beach Chair Set Up (March 1st - October 31st)• 2 Complimentary Adult Beach Cruiser BicyclesMAIN FLOOR: (Sleeps 6)PRIMARY BEDROOM: king-size bed (Sleeps 2)GUEST BEDROOM: queen-size bed, twin-over-twin-size bed (Sleeps 4)LIVING AREADINING AREAKITCHENLAUNDRY NOOKFULL BATHROOMOUTDOOR, GULFRONT BALCONY
